milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The smooth sandstone slabs are placed at the building entrance path (spawn-relative ~1-2, y-1, z2-4) and as interior flooring (x2-7, y0, z6-10). The target is set to the center of the interior slab area (~4, 0, ~7) with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60, modeling that the player has navigated near the slabs and is looking at them.

Uses inventory_has because mining a red sandstone wall with a pickaxe drops the block as an item into the player's inventory. The scene provides an iron pickaxe, so the block will drop itself. This is the most reliable way to confirm mining occurred — the player must have at least 1 red_sandstone_wall item in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task. The stone pressure plate is at spawn-relative (5, 0, 11), hidden behind the red sandstone wall at z=9. The player must mine through the wall to access the hidden chamber (z=10-11) and look at the pressure plate. max_distance=5 ensures the player is in or very near the hidden chamber, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the plate. This area is only accessible after mining the red sandstone wall.
